summary: Current catalog/viewer correctly rejects metric claims and restricted bundled geometry. Two concrete publication inconsistencies remain in the accuracy baseline and Kailasa preview lineage; no fabricated survey-accuracy claim or synthetic detail was found in the reviewed asset labels.

findings.finding: Accuracy baseline still describes the old church/mosque Blender inspection GLBs as the current GLB state.

evidence.observed: sourceTopologyPreservedInGlb=false and importedTriangles 3757757/3104122 appear as the current baseline without route/hash qualification.
The 11/12-face Blender losses are explained, but the instruction to describe the GLBs as not topology-identical has no explicit contrast with the new preserving route.
Published church/mosque counts are 3757768/3104134; current summaries distinguish preserving conversion.
Preservation flags pass; output.web SHA256 5e3041a6e99cdfec75c8b992a34c6115efa6047cec885d0807ea96458b1e09a6; separate previewInspection has 3757757 triangles.
Preservation flags pass; output.web SHA256 2051d43a9ad92d0d51300cdddbc7888258897b07b02e1ff9a6bf34cb39a02c67; separate previewInspection has 3104122 triangles.

findings.impact: Readers and downstream tools can wrongly conclude that the downloadable current GLBs still lose faces, or apply an old inspection result to a new artifact. The contract and publishing evidence contradict one another despite correct runtime counts.
findings.proposedFix: Split currentBaseline into explicitly named immutable source, published preserving GLB and prior Blender inspection records, binding each to its evidence path/hash and counts. Update ACCURACY with the same route table; say current indices/counts are preserved while decimal-to-Float32 conversion remains disclosed. Keep the 11/12-loss records as historical inspection evidence, not current published topology.
acceptance: Published-route counts equal catalog and preservation receipts (3757768 and 3104134).
Prior Blender route alone carries counts 3757757/3104122 and removal 11/12 with unknown cause.
Every route has an artifact hash or precise evidence reference; no ambiguous sourceTopologyPreservedInGlb boolean remains in a mixed current record.
No claim of exact decimal-coordinate preservation or metric verification is introduced.

findings.finding: Kailasa preview and published-model face counts differ without the explicit UI disclosure already supplied for church and mosque.

evidence.observed: Published triangles=136499; previewNote mentions only a Blender render of coarse context.
previewNote is the user-visible preview description, while the adjacent record displays the published GLB count.

findings.impact: The preview may be mistaken for an exact render of the newly preserved 136499-triangle artifact. The evidence is present but its route distinction is not shown at the same point of use.
findings.proposedFix: Add the Kailasa 136499 published / 136498 earlier Blender inspection distinction to previewNote and the accuracy lineage table. Retain the older render if clearly identified; do not infer a face-removal cause. Bind any later replacement preview to the exact input hash and new receipt.
acceptance: Selecting Kailasa explicitly distinguishes the preview-import count from the download count.
Catalog preview metadata agrees with evidence.previewInspection and the preserving receipt.
No automatic mesh alteration or synthetic repair is introduced to make counts agree.

findings.finding: The collection README currently describes three completed improvement rounds while the frozen ledger contains Round 1 and Round 2 is in progress.

evidence.observed: States that the panel improved the collection across three implementation rounds.
Calls for independent review and accepted fixes before Round 3.

findings.impact: The frozen artifact overstates completed review history at this point in the workflow. This can become truthful after the moderator completes and records all rounds.
findings.proposedFix: Use in-progress wording until completion, or make final publication conditional on complete four-expert receipts and changed-artifact identities for all three rounds.
acceptance: Final publication wording matches actually completed ledger rounds and their artifact identities.
A missing review round cannot be represented as passed merely by future intent.

passedChecks.finding: Unsupported physical measurement claims are blocked.
passedChecks.detail: All seven assets require metric.verified=false, units/crs/error=null and measurementEnabled=false. Viewer labels scale/accuracy unverified and has no measurement control.

passedChecks.finding: Observed geometry, processed context, completeness and unknowns remain distinct.
passedChecks.detail: Giza derivatives disclose upstream rescaling/simplification. Plateau and Kailasa context disclose incomplete/coarse coverage. Church/mosque identify actual named exteriors and captured RGB. Full-source geometry is described as supplied-data preservation, not a complete building.

passedChecks.finding: Restricted Cave 16 and view-only references do not become public geometry.
passedChecks.detail: Public assets are CC-BY-4.0; references have no bundled file. Klein is CC-BY-NC-4.0, unregistered and source-only; Sidhu/iTek remain external references. Credits distinguish the GSXNet context from these detail sources.

passedChecks.finding: Accuracy acceptance targets remain proposals with independent evidence requirements.
passedChecks.detail: 5cm/1cm/1mm P95 targets are not claimed achieved. Independent held-out checks, spatial strata, maximum error, unknown-not-zero budgets and current-versus-historical layers are specified.

passedChecks.finding: Reviewed source identities, creators and licenses agree with recorded primary-source provenance.
passedChecks.detail: Original model UUIDs, creator handles and dataset records remain traceable. This pass did not perform fresh legal clearance or re-fetch source license pages.

tests.scope: Actual published bytes/hashes/density/preservation checks, restricted-source rejection, metric-claim rejection, bounded paths/files, external-resource rejection and vendor receipt checks

tests.command: SHA256 comparison of 33 publication files against round-1-artifact.json

limits: Read-only implementation review; only this report was written.
No new web research, model download, metric survey, provider request, engine run or browser interaction.
Existing source evidence and actual focused tests were used; no new claim that all hidden/interior surfaces or source capture rights were verified.
The current seven models remain useful visual references and do not satisfy the requested complete extreme-detail measured result.
